The Fish Steward is appointed by the village head with community input and can be changed at the annual council meeting. 8. Villagers with a net shortfall (quota minus weight) are identified as lower catchers. 9. The surplus pool is first allocated to the lowest shortfalls, giving each enough to reach quota. 10. Remaining surplus is divided equally among the remaining lower catchers. 11. Villagers who met or exceeded quota receive nothing from the pool. 12.
